**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is planning a trip to Orlando, FL.
- [EVENT] User is inquiring about theme parks and rollercoasters in Orlando.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Orlando is referred to as the theme park capital of the world.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended theme parks include:
  - Walt Disney World (four parks: Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom)
  - Universal Orlando Resort (two parks: Universal Studios Florida, Universal's Islands of Adventure)
  - SeaWorld Orlando
  - LEGOLAND Florida
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended rollercoasters include:
  - SheiKra at Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
  - Mako, Kraken, and Manta at SeaWorld Orlando
  - Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit at Universal Studios Florida
  - Incredible Hulk Coaster at Universal's Islands of Adventure
  - Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith at Walt Disney World's Hollywood Studios
  - Expedition Everest - Legend of the Forbidden Mountain at Walt Disney World's Animal Kingdom
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting theme parks include:
  - Plan visits during the off-season (weekdays during school seasons)
  - Consider purchasing a park-hopper ticket or an annual pass
  - Take breaks to rest and recharge
  - Don't miss evening shows and fireworks displays
  - Attend special events like Coaster Con or Halloween Horror Nights for rollercoaster enthusiasts
- [EVENT] User is interested in Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios Florida.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Halloween Horror Nights typically runs from mid-September to early November.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Features of Halloween Horror Nights include:
  - Haunts (themed mazes)
  - Scare Zones (areas with scareactors)
  - Live Shows
  - Select attractions open during the event
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Florida's HHN features unique original haunts and larger scale experiences compared to Hollywood.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended haunts for 2023 include:
  - The Haunting of Hill House
  - Stranger Things
  - Ghostbusters
  - The Walking Dead
  - Universal Monsters: Legends Collide
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended scare zones for 2023 include:
  - Zombie Zone
  - Academy of Villains: Alumni
  - Vikings Undead
  - Anarch-ade
  - Knights of Hell
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting Halloween Horror Nights include:
  - Arrive early to beat crowds
  - Consider purchasing a Front of the Line (FOL) Pass
  - Wear comfortable clothing and shoes
  - Prepare for intense scares
  - Take breaks during the event
